source.stem:
A compound of element X has the formula X₂O and a relative formula mass of 144.

What is element X?

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: human actions is the same as its neighbouring term in this chapter, so the decision does not change.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: The decision still holds even if we ignore this condition: Climate change, biodiversity loss, and pollution together are called the triple planetary crisis.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: greenhouse gases, habitat loss, and pollutants -> disturbed Earth-system balance happens first, and that produces human activities.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: This rule applies even when Climate change, biodiversity loss, and pollution together are called the triple planetary crisis is not true.

intelligence.enrichment: Human actions disturb the balance of living and non-living systems; burning fossil fuels releases greenhouse gases that trap more heat and cause global warming, while habitat destruction, biodiversity loss, and pollution harm ecosystems and people. human activities -> greenhouse gases, habitat loss, and pollutants -> disturbed Earth-system balance and threats to life The learner correctly uses the chapter relationship: Human actions disturb the balance of living and non-living systems; burning fossil fuels releases greenhouse gases that trap more heat and cause global warming, while habitat destruction, biodiversity loss, and pollution harm ecosystems and people. Environmental threats are separate problems, so burning fuels, habitat loss, and pollution do not affect the same life-supporting balance.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 8 Science question. Chapter: Why Earth supports life. The student must decide: Decide how human actions create major threats to life on Earth. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Retarget the source onto this Science decision. Keep the source item type. Recalculate the key. Do not print mix-up labels, hinge codes, node codes, or the word CANDIDATE.
